seoDescription: Learn to expertly set the time and date on your Casio AQ-S810W with this comprehensive tutorial. The guide provides step-by-step instructions for adjusting the city code (time zone), toggling Daylight Saving Time (DST), and switching between 12 and 24-hour formats. It covers setting the year, month, day, hour, and minute, plus advanced customizations like button tones, illumination duration, and display language. Crucially, this walkthrough also teaches how to perform a hand alignment to fix and synchronize the analog hands with the digital time display.

chapters.description: This section walks through the process of setting the current month and day to complete the date configuration.

chapters.title: Adjusting the Illumination Duration
chapters.description: Learn to change the backlight duration, choosing between a 1.5-second or 3-second light.

summary:
## Entering & Navigating Settings
*   **Enter Settings:** From the timekeeping screen, **press and hold the Adjust button** (top-left) until the watch beeps and the city code flashes.
*   **Navigate:** Press the **Mode button** (bottom-left) to cycle through different settings (Time Zone -> DST -> 12/24h -> Seconds, etc.).
*   **Change Values:** Use a combination of the **Light button** (top-right) and **Search button** (bottom-right) to adjust the flashing value.
*   **Save & Exit:** Press the **Adjust button** once to save all changes and return to the main screen.

## Time, Date, and Customization Cycle
> [!NOTE]
> The settings appear in a specific, repeating order. You can cycle through all of them using the **Mode** button.

1.  **City Code:** Set your home time zone.
2.  **DST:** Toggle Daylight Saving Time `ON` or `OFF`.
3.  **12/24-Hour Format:** Choose your preferred time display format.
4.  **Seconds:** Reset to `00` by pressing the **Search** button.
5.  **Hour & Minute:** Adjust to your local time.
6.  **Year, Month, & Day:** Set the calendar date.
7.  **Button Tone:** `KEY` enables the button beep; `MUTE` disables it.
8.  **Illumination Duration:** `LT1` for 1.5 seconds, `LT3` for 3 seconds.
9.  **Language:** Select the language for the day-of-the-week display (English, Spanish, French, etc.).

## Calibrating Analog Hands (H-SET)
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Perform this step only if the analog hands do not show the same time as the digital display after you've set the time.

1.  **Enter H-SET Mode:** From the main timekeeping screen, **press and hold the Adjust button** for about 5-6 seconds, past the initial beep, until `H-SET` appears. Release the button.
2.  **Check Alignment:** The hands should automatically move to the 12 o'clock position. Both the hour and minute hand should point directly at 12.
3.  **Correct Position:** If they are not perfectly aligned at 12:00, use the **Light and Search buttons** to manually move them until they are. You can press and hold for faster scrolling.
4.  **Save Calibration:** Press the **Adjust button** once. The hands will now automatically move to match the correct digital time you previously set.
